_comment: Unit 6's second batch - the yap families the reader named next.
Every entry here is a short span rather than a whole sentence: the pointer is a
clause inside a fact ("the reason availability can be promised in a contract
(Unit 8.3)"), so cutting the clause leaves the fact exact. That is also why the
spans avoid markup: a rewrite is refused when it has to touch text inside a tag,
and choosing the smallest span is what keeps these resoluble.
